text:
- **Codex support:** The Codex gap list is written, and each gap is closed on a branch or kept by a project decision. pm now takes the root Codex session id first.
- **Test and CI quality:** The test suite now keeps only tests with unique value, and all bug guards remain. CI now runs a lint gate that stops weak code patterns in new code.
- **Public site and website:** A Go port of the Cloudflare Access check is merged, and it accepts only app-type tokens. A one-page pm website is now live on GitHub Pages.
- **Review pending pull requests:** Check the open pull requests on pm. Then trust pm's Codex hooks once in each repo you use Codex in.
